news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics stock: Analysts trim target ahead of Q3 results
news.summary: Analysts reportedly trimmed price targets on PRCT in the run-up to the November 4 Q3 report, tempering some of the late-October optimism. It signals that expectations are being reset cautiously despite the recent rebound.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics (PRCT) Expected to Beat Earnings Estimates: Can the Stock Move Higher?
news.summary: A Zacks earnings preview flags PROCEPT as a candidate to beat consensus estimates when it reports Q3 results on November 4. The preview adds to the more constructive tone around the stock heading into the print.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics: Compelling Bet On Aquablation's Growth
news.summary: A bullish Seeking Alpha piece argues Aquablation adoption and procedure growth make PROCEPT a compelling long at depressed valuations ahead of Q3 results.

news.headline: Piper Sandler Initiates PROCEPT BioRobotics With Buy Rating, $25 Price Target
news.summary: Piper Sandler started coverage of PRCT with a Buy rating and a $25 price target, adding a bullish voice as the stock tried to recover from its lows. The initiation helped fuel the mid-to-late October rebound.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics to Report Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results on November 4, 2026
news.summary: PROCEPT will release Q3 2026 results after market close on November 4, 2026, with a conference call at 4:30 p.m. ET. Investors will look for progress against the reiterated $390-410M full-year revenue guidance.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics Upgraded at Barclays
news.summary: Barclays upgraded its rating on PRCT, one of several more constructive analyst moves in October following the stock's steep decline to multi-year lows.

news.headline: PROCEPT BioRobotics Extends CIBC Term Loan Maturity to Oct 2028 Under Third Amendment
news.summary: Through a third amendment to its credit agreement, PROCEPT extended the maturity of its CIBC term loan by one year to October 2028. The extension eases near-term balance-sheet pressure while the company works toward profitability.

catalysts.label: Q3 2026 earnings report
catalysts.detail: Officially announced for November 4 after market close (call 4:30 p.m. ET). Key test for U.S. HYDROS system placements and procedure growth (Q2: 13,100+ U.S. procedures, +21%) against a ~$100.5M consensus Q3 revenue estimate and the reiterated $390-410M full-year revenue guide, plus gross-margin trajectory and cash burn.

pulse: PROCEPT shares rebounded from multi-year lows to around $19-20 in the second half of October, helped by a Barclays upgrade and a Piper Sandler Buy initiation ($25 target), though some analysts trimmed targets just before earnings and consensus remains Hold, far below the 52-week high near $67. Q2 showed revenue +19% to $94.5M with $390-410M full-year guidance reiterated, the CIBC loan maturity was pushed to 2028, and Zacks previews lean toward a Q3 beat against a ~$100.5M revenue consensus. The November 4 Q3 report is the key near-term test of HYDROS placements, procedure growth and cash burn.
